title: Classical ambitions, Juilliard pianists and Robert Harris
summary: She plans classical writing, dismissed Juilliard pianists with high hands, and credits Robert Harris.

blocks.x: of happy I got away from them. But that's the reason why I'm afraid if I played the classics and went all the way with it I'd lose the feeling of the greatest (now I'm not putting the classics down) - the greatest music that I think has ever been -'cause I can write the classics and everything here. I can write that too you know, once I get into it. One day - my husband, he was kind of mean, said, "You better save your money 'cause you'll be old." Here I'm 22 - "and you won't be able to play." I said, "I'll be playing when I'm 100 years old." And I believe so. That's from here, you know, because I'll be playing because he made a dirty remark. I'm about 22 and he's going to tell me I'm not going to play, save your money, and all that. But I like classical music and as I told you before I get my inspirations from it. But I don't want to go into it. I had 5 Juilliard pianists that come here for lessons and I had to let them all go because they taught them with their hands up here. Jazz you hug the keys. Like when the phone rang Hilton called me, Hilton Ruiz, I helped him, piano. He was doing all this with his hands up too high. I said, "You better drop your hands down on those keys." But probably with his fingers like that, he was fast.
Oh, about the position of the hands.

You see, that's something else. Now, I'm going to play classical music, I'm sure, before I die, because ever since a little kid I wanted to do that. But I'm so involved with this and these other things that I like about jazz, see. I'm going to write some classical things and play them. The greatest concert pianist, Robert Harris - I don't think you met him but he's usually at my parties - he teaches over at Juilliard and if you ever want to know the piano and learn how to play the piano, get to him. I hurt my fingers and I went to him and he gave me exercises to do, just not on the keys but other things to do. His teacher was the teacher of Clyde - what's his name - that went to Europe, the young kid that went to Europe -
Van Cliburn, yes, and so he is sensational in teaching.
Is it really possible to shift over to classical music after -

Very possible. I had a pupil here and she was playing Bach and I had to teach her how to memorize and how to really play it. In about 5 minutes I was playing 4 bars. You understand?
